info.title: PhonePe Clone API
info.description:
A PhonePe-style payments backend with a double-entry ledger and integer-paise money handling.

### Money
Requests take rupees (`amount`, max 2 decimal places — more precision is rejected with 400).
Responses return both `amount` (rupees) and `amountPaise` (exact integer). Nothing is ever stored as a float.

### Authentication
Call `POST /api/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 30 days and can be
revoked with `POST /api/auth/logout`.

### MPIN
Every outbound payment needs the 4-6 digit MPIN. Set it with `POST /api/auth/setup-mpin`.
Five wrong attempts lock the account for 15 minutes — the counter is per-account, not per-IP.

### Idempotency
Money endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Repeating a request with the same key replays the
original response instead of moving money twice.

### Seeded test accounts
After `npm run seed`: `amit@example.com` / `priya@example.com` / `rahul@example.com` / `neha@example.com`,
all with password `password123` and MPIN `1234`.

attemptsLeft.description: Attempts remaining before the account locks

token.description: JWT, valid 30 days. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

LedgerEntry.description: One side of a double-entry pair. Debits and credits for a transaction always sum to zero.

idempotent.description: true when this is a replayed response, not a new transfer

Reconciliation.description: Compares the materialized balance against the sum of the ledger. Non-zero drift indicates a bug.

participants.description: Shares are computed in exact paise and always sum to the total.

Mandate.description: An autopay mandate. The MPIN is verified once at creation and never stored — that verification is the authorization for future automatic runs.

degraded.description: true when a dependency circuit is open but the API is still serving

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired token

IncorrectMpin.description: Incorrect MPIN (attemptsLeft counts down to lockout)

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted to act on this resource

example.message: You are not authorized to view this transaction

Conflict.description: Resource is not in a state that allows this action

RateLimited.description: Rate limited, or MPIN lockout active

example.message: Too many incorrect MPIN attempts. Try again in 15 minute(s).

ServerError.description: Unexpected error (consistent shape, never a stack trace)

example.message: Something went wrong on our end

get.summary: This OpenAPI document as raw JSON
get.description: For client codegen or importing into other tools. The interactive UI is at /api-docs.
Used by nginx for passive health checks and Docker for HEALTHCHECK. Also reports queue and circuit-breaker state, so one call tells you whether dependencies are healthy.

post.summary: Register a new user
post.description: Creates the account, assigns a random UPI ID, and credits the opening balance as a real ledger-backed ADD_MONEY transaction (so a new user has one entry in their history, not zero).

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT
post.description: Rate limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP to blunt password brute-forcing.

post.summary: Set or change the transaction MPIN
Revoke the current token
post.description: Adds the token to a blacklist until its natural expiry, which is how a stateless JWT gets a working logout.

post.summary: Request a password-reset OTP by email
post.description: Responds identically whether or not the email is registered, so this endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts. The OTP is queued (retried with backoff) rather than sent inline.

post.summary: Reset the password using an emailed OTP

delete.description: History is retained; the account can no longer authenticate or log in. Also revokes the current token.

post.summary: Send money by phone number or UPI ID
post.description: The debit is a single conditional atomic update, so concurrent transfers cannot overdraw the account. Supports Idempotency-Key for safe retries.

post.description: Only the receiver of a TRANSFER can refund it. Omit `amount` to refund the full remaining balance. Over-refunding is prevented by an atomic conditional claim.

post.summary: Create an autopay mandate
post.description: The MPIN is verified once here — that verification IS the authorization for future runs, matching how real e-mandates work. It is never stored. The worker then executes without any credential, and you can pause or cancel at any time.

amount.description: Amount in rupees, max 2 decimal places. Rejected with 400 if more precise.

startAt.description: Optional first run. Defaults to one interval from now, so nothing charges immediately.

post.summary: Pause an active mandate
Resume a paused or failed mandate
post.description: Never resumes into the past — if nextRunAt has already passed it's pushed to the next interval.
